name: Exploding Kittens
summary: A last-player-standing card game where players avoid drawing an Exploding Kitten from a shared deck.
rules_text: Remove Exploding Kittens and Defuses. Shuffle rest and deal 4 cards face down to each player plus 1 Defuse each for 5 total, hidden. Put back Kittens equal to players minus one and remaining Defuses, shuffle to form draw pile. On your turn you may play any number of cards face up to the discard: Attack forces next player to take two turns, Skip ends your turn without drawing, Favor makes a chosen player give you a card of their choice, Shuffle randomizes draw pile, See the Future peeks at top three in order, pair of same artless Cat cards steals a random card, Nope cancels any other action and can be played any time even off-turn and can be Noped. After playing, you must draw one card from draw pile. If it's an Exploding Kitten, you either play a Defuse to secretly reinsert it anywhere in draw pile, or you explode, discard all cards and are eliminated. Last player remaining wins.
rating_reason: Specific hidden-hand elimination card game with bluffing and combos
